source.author: verg
source.text: Salve, sancte parens: iterum salvete, recepti nequiquam cineres, animaeque umbraeque paternae.
source.text_original: 'Salve, sancte parens: iterum salvete, recepti / nequiquam cineres, animaeque umbraeque paternae.
source.text_english: Hail, holy father: and again, hail, recovered in vain ashes, and ancestral souls and shades.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: versam proles tua pandet Idumen namque potest : Solymo nigrantem pulvere fratrem spargentemque faces et in omni turre furentem.
reuse.text_original: versam proles tua pandet Idumen / (namque potest ): Solymo nigrantem pulvere fratrem / spargentemque faces et in omni turre furentem.
reuse.text_english: Your offspring will reveal Idumea turned over, for it can: the brother darkened with dust of Jerusalem, scattering torches and raging in every tower.
